The '''Prindaar system''', also known as the '''Antar system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Antar/Legends|Antar]] and its six [[Moon/Legends|moons]], four of which supported life, including [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] and the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on [[Antar 5]]. The [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]], the final resting place of the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], was one of the uninhabitable moons orbiting Antar. In the center of the system were two [[Binary star system/Legends|binary stars]], [[Prindaar]] and [[Antar (star)|Antar]]. The system was home to the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
